name: Receiving and long-stock racks
specification: Cantilever stock racks, wheelset cradles, protected stores, quarantine, heat/serial tagging and contained handling. Rate rack, aisle and floor to vendor packages and actual loads.

name: Guarded section and liner saw
specification: 350 × 320 mm reference throat, positive clamp, input/output roller support and 12 m finished chord access with incoming trim allowance. Prove largest section and full-length cut. Include mains, coolant, chip containment and blade-change access.

name: Bench preparation and liner drilling
specification: Guarded drill with replaceable liner bushings and countersink stop, deburr bench and finish/squareness gauges, with local dust extraction. Demonstrate six positions per liner, edge distance, flushness and mate fit.

name: Nested plate blank supply
specification: Cut and mark 8 mm gussets and 12 mm pads, allow finish stock, capture mill heat, flatness and edge condition. Reserve equivalent capacity at supplier; handoff queue and transport outside cell hours.

name: Indexed 17 m body build bed
specification: 18 × 3.2 m concept envelope, modular surveyed bed, replaceable locator towers, clamps, door and splice bridge inserts, equipment escape and lift access. Include crew/vacancy for each scheduled bed and prove geometry with load and hot-to-cold checks.

name: Removable bogie frame weld bed
specification: 3.2 × 2.5 m concept envelope, pin axle planes from railhead and use removable seat locators, open gauging windows and rated handling after clamp release. Demonstrate repeatability after thermal cycles.

name: Mobile pulsed MIG/MAG and source capture
specification: 400 A class pulsed unit with compatible gun, gas distribution and extraction at each active station. Return rated current at expected ambient and arc duty, actual input demand, airflow and simultaneous draw. Time assumes single occupied set per cell task; validate peak overlap of both body beds and bogie bed.

name: Shared runway handling and rigging
specification: Rate for heaviest actual lifted assembly, certified spreaders, slings, support reactions, headroom and travel. Dedicated bulk moves booked to one resource across receiving and bays.

name: Shared portable tracker and dimensional QA
specification: One tracker with survey targets, probe and calibrated local gauges. Verify plant temperature, setup uncertainty and repeated datum survey before moving between cells.

name: Weld inspection and NDT
specification: Series QA visual inspection during work and periodic contract NDT with approved method for each location and procedure. Joint times are booking proxies. Access, extent and qualification controlled by approved plan.

name: Contract bogie seat and datum machining
specification: Single datum registration across both axle planes, finish seats and mating holes under approved drawing. Confirm spindle reach, fixture and probing repeatability. Book freight and supplier queue separately.

name: Contract blast and coating
specification: Process 17 m body and bogie frames; verify fixture access, blast/film/cure checks, masking and drains. Separate transport and painted-part storage.

name: Bogie integration with clean stands
specification: Positive anti-roll support and keyed axle cradle, calibrated torque tooling and verified lift fixtures. Fit approved drive, spring, stops and brake assemblies with tool windows and full-load clearances.

name: Wheelset and supplier bearing assembly
specification: Procure certified wheelsets and mounted bearings under supplier procedures. Review journal fit, manufacturer endplay and retained force-displacement trace where applicable; supplier assembly resource only.

name: Restrained bogie functional stand
specification: Protected stand, logged drive/brake and leak function to approved plan, electrical and fluid isolation and measured alignment. Repeated thermal and braking proof requires independently agreed instrumentation and loads.

name: Portal and liner fixture with door support trolley
specification: Replaceable liner drill template, flush screw and retention gauges, 1,300 mm clear-aperture gauge and finite-travel surrogate plus door handling trolley. Fixture use is an occupation subtotal inside the body fit operation.

name: Body mechanical and cabin fit
specification: Movable platforms, hand tools, depth/torque tools and nominated support for roof lift. Complete roof, door, interior and external weather sealing check; supplier BOM pending for several fitout groups.

name: Electrical cabinet and harness build benches
specification: ESD and isolated power, enclosure drilling/marking, crimp and pull verification, keyed boards and adapters, cable/hose service loops, strain relief and calibrated bond checks. Bench occupation per vehicle kit pending conductor, cabinet and connector schedule. Purchase safety electronics and prequalified HV modules.

name: Shared cabinet and harness tester
specification: Expandable continuity/IR tester, keyed drawings and adapter plates, controlled test voltages and isolation for sensitive components, interlocked test cover, reference checks and serial logs. Count per car kit pending actual harness list.

name: Onboard collector set install tools
specification: Portable locator and insulated isolation kit. Return spring/contact limits, polarity, terminal access and stroke checks for car-role allocation under an approved test.

name: Body lift and marriage road
specification: Synchronized rated lift set and mechanical supports with verified concentrated floor loads, guarded pallet/cradle and approved lifting points. Use separate maintenance equipment for repair road. Record load balance, lift movement, shim stack, retention and service coupling.

name: Static integration and factory acceptance test road
specification: Calibrated equipped-car wheel-load system and isolation, bonding, controlled LV/drive and brake witness equipment. Data recorder links each serial and test revision. Separate full-train static booking and independent route qualification.

name: Set-level integration and controls test road
specification: Book a staging or test track long enough for six 17 m cars, actual coupler gaps, access and clearances. Protect and isolate test area. Interface the inter-car wiring, controls, braking, fault handling and emergency release in a witnessed static test.

name: Off-line exchange and repair road
specification: Dedicated approved jack/support and rail pallet, wheel gauges, isolation and repair benches. One hour/car is a reserved occupation allowance, pending reject rates and equipped exchange trials. Reserve repair crew separately. Use a distinct depot budget for the road and contracted overhaul.

name: Wet-cast box mould and prestress position
specification: 10 m closed box with separable core, removable bulkheads, 180 mm webs, 200 mm slabs and cast ends. Prove core extraction and restrain core flotation. Qualify the complete reaction system for the two aligned six-strand banks, eccentricity and unbalanced release.
note: Base case assumes 24 elapsed hours per box and one independently occupied box per position. The guide sizes the 48-hour and two-position alternative.

name: Beam reinforcement cage build and check jig
specification: Provide coordinated cut-and-bend feed and cage stock staging. Gauge U-bar laps, cover, strand setbacks, inserts and dense end reinforcement. Validate the assumed staffed cycle with a timed cage.

name: Calibrated stressing and controlled detensioning plant
specification: Include jack, pump, gauges, release equipment and functioning calibrated checks, elongations, anchor heads, working tails and exclusion zones. Return the approved load and sequence for each independent line.

name: Shared batching and concrete delivery to placement crews
specification: Trial 20 m³/h gross placement feed. Verify actual net yield, mix families, humidity/temperature controls, batch traceability, test frequency, transport and staggered placements.
note: Both lines draw on this service. Planned panel peaks require a separate concurrent placement check.

name: Beam placement, vibration and finishing crews
specification: Trial two occupied crew hours per box including placement, vibration and finish. Sequence releases, supply of fresh concrete and pour continuity across multiple moulds. Staff early and late windows if demanded by the staggered 24-hour return.

name: Beam yard lifting and trailer loadout
specification: Approve actual hook load and rigging geometry for removal and dunnage placement plus trailer loadout. Confirm safe crane travel, pick path, actual span and independent cage/core lifting arrangements.

name: Single-tier beam storage and dispatch buffer
specification: Trial allowance 176 single-tier beam slots based on monthly release profile, with designed dunnage, lateral restraint, survey and serial number access. Add separately circulating routes, quarantine and repair access.
note: Stock buffer uses peak inventory rather than cumulative processing hours.

name: Beam tractor, matched trailer and haul crew
specification: One beam per trip. Return surveyed access, wheel loads, restraints, permits, escorted route and actual pick/set readiness. Synchronise eight loads to each eight-lift day.
note: Four-hour round-trip sensitivity includes yard and front dwell. Full eight-hour transport window is a trial. A usable seven-hour window permits only one complete round trip per set if trips must start and finish in that window.

name: Foundation, column and cap work areas
specification: Record soil, utilities, excavation, base bearing, settlement and flood/seismic limits. Return site-specific stage hours, crew/rig choices, curing, test hold and approved seat elevations.
note: No rated site production quantity. At eight pier positions/day, each day of release-stage occupancy adds eight open positions. Derive rigs, forms and crews from the boreholes, surveyed access and first installed support.

name: Bearing seat survey and installation crews
specification: Verify bearing contact, edge distances, axes, rotation and keeper engagement, drainage, survey and future jack access. Confirm approved anchor, grout and movement interfaces.
note: 0.2 hours per bearing is an active alignment and inspection allowance. Add grout cure stage occupancy to the verified support calendar.

name: Site erection front and at-radius crane service
specification: Include site crane, approved rig and crew, site access and traffic control. Return actual configuration chart, ground pressures, paved and off-road travel, slew and lift clearances, weather limits, temporary restraints and signed seat release.
note: Six active hook hours in each eight-hour possession after 1.5 hours for setup/reposition/closeout and 0.5 hours for interruption. 0.75 hours per lift includes spotting, pick, slew, seat and release.

name: Flat station panel casting table
specification: Trial four table places for one standard bay per productive day. Use adaptable shutters and gauges for connections, edge, crossfall, inserts and tolerance.
note: Repeat of trial 4.98 × 1.98 × 0.28 m panel. Final demand and mix of panel sizes are open.

name: Panel strip, yard and dispatch handling
specification: Return tested insert and handling scheme for each size, verified minimum strength, lifting weight, surveyed protective storage and segregated handling window.

name: Adjustable enclosure and removable backplate assembly stand
specification: Adjustable stops, replaceable drilling template, insulated terminal and label kit, controlled torque tools and ESD provision as applicable. Obtain enclosure dimensions, assembly mass, lifting and safe work envelope before specifying the stand.

name: Wire preparation, labelled kitting and crimp inspection station
specification: Provide cut-to-length and strip tools, interchangeable calibrated dies, label printer, terminal samples and a pull-test instrument. Agree conductor sizes, ferrules, polarity, tooling/die compatibility and supplier acceptance limits. HV busbars, contact rail and power cables belong to their power-system lots.

name: Isolated low-voltage I/O proving bench with removable test harness
disposition: build jig and buy calibrated instruments
specification: Provide isolated supply, point-to-point breakout, simulated contacts/loads, independent recorder and per-revision adapters. Capture wrong addressing and loss of supply or feedback. Return calibration, test duration and evidence for each serial. Live fault-duty and protection discrimination remain separate witnessed trials.

name: Supplier switchgear and rectifier test provision
specification: Return tested assemblies per site, ratings, rigs, inspection capacity, traceable results and independent witnessing allowance. The 30 source groups are installation locations. The manufactured cabinet count is open.
